intro: Gokarna is one of those places that stays with you long after the trip ends. Goa's quieter, wilder neighbour — and it is easier to plan than you might think.

sections.heading: Why visit Gokarna
paragraphs: Gokarna (Karnataka) is known for its beach, backpacking and spiritual experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to March.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Carry cash and a torch for the beach trek.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Gokarna?

faq.a: Train to Gokarna Road station or about 3 hours by road from Goa airport.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Gokarna?
faq.a: Popular choices: Kudle Beach for cafés; Om Beach for views; Town for temples.
